title: Spatial Cognition and Metaphor in Hungarian Grammar
grammar: Cognitive Metaphors and Spatial Conceptualization in Hungarian
goal: I can explain how Hungarian spatial cases are used for abstract ideas (*bízik valakiben*, *kétségbe esik*).
I can read set phrases that picture an idea as a container, a surface or a path.
I can write a short analysis of a Hungarian figurative phrase.
